evidence_gate.interpretation: K3 replaces K2's tail-only statistic with the identifiable common component of s(v,p)=a(p)+b(r)+epsilon. Source normal crops estimate b(r) and robust noise scale; inverse-variance aggregation estimates the shared physical field a(p). The fixed estimator must beat ordinary mean before independent-roll confirmation.

novelty_boundary.method_requirement: The estimator must improve over unweighted overlap mean under identical observations by explicitly removing learned crop-coordinate bias and weighting observation noise without defect supervision.

context_response_calibration.score: pattern-conditional empirical upper-tail of one-sided robust residual energy
context_response_calibration.physical_field_estimator: inverse-robust-variance weighted mean after crop-relative median bias removal

ablation_estimators.context_bias_equal_mean: equal mean after crop-relative median bias removal
ablation_estimators.context_scale_weighted_mean: inverse-robust-variance weighted raw response without bias removal

fixed_candidate_gate.scope: K3 replaces K2's tail-only statistic with the identifiable common component of s(v,p)=a(p)+b(r)+epsilon. Source normal crops estimate b(r) and robust noise scale; inverse-variance aggregation estimates the shared physical field a(p). The fixed estimator must beat ordinary mean before independent-roll confirmation.
